purpose: Establish the normally installed game directory and registration needed for subsequent REA consumer analysis.
proposed_execution: Confirm fixed original game setup execution and its corresponding installation UAC at action time, disclosing unsigned/unverified origin.
Check fresh exact guest window, installer hash and selected existing destination state before starting once through the normal UI.
Use normal interactive installation, record actual prompts/destination and stop on newly presented binding terms or unexpected access/security changes.
Inspect and deselect postinstall launch options before finishing. Do not silently accept terms or allow unobserved child execution.
Read back actual installed directory, selected file hashes and registry view after the installer terminates. Select a later game observation profile only for verified installed identity.
excluded_actions: No fabricated registry/IPC or substitute directory writes.
No CG5Reg manual registration, silent installer or policy weakening.
No replay of current.ps1/Restore or consumed prior quotas.
No account/credential collection, protection bypass, memory unpacking or unverified game execution.
No unchecked uninstaller or automatic snapshot restoration.

cu_policy_basis.source: mcp__cua_repl documentation: Computer/Browser Use Confirmation Policy, Confirmation Required at Action time
cu_policy_basis.rule: Installs or runs software from an unrecognized source: Uses software obtained outside a well-known package registry, official vendor website, or official extension marketplace.
cu_policy_basis.scope: Next normal interactive installer execution only. Existing ordinary Windows/network/tool authorization remains valid.
